title: Marcos recalls 'karaoke session' with Japan PM Takaichi
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. held a bilateral meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on the sidelines of the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits on Monday, November 16.
